title: Conifer Plugin Manifest
description: Portable manifest describing a Conifer agent plugin: MCP servers, optional code hooks, and agent instructions.

name.description: Plugin identifier: lowercase, digits, and hyphens; must start with a letter.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the plugin provides.

mcp.description: MCP servers this plugin connects to.

hooks.$comment: Non-portable: hooks reference local code and do not transfer to other harnesses or gateway hosting.
hooks.description: Map of hook name to a local module reference, e.g. "preToolCall": "./hooks.js#audit".

instructions.description: Instructions appended to the system prompt of agents that load this plugin.

name.description: Server name; namespaces the tools it provides.

transport.description: How to reach the MCP server.

env.description: Environment variables for the spawned process. Values may interpolate ${VAR} from the host environment.

headers.description: HTTP headers (http transport). Values may interpolate ${VAR}.

toolAllowlist.description: If present, only these tools from the server are exposed to the agent.
